role: The trading interface: customer bookkeeping, the recipe list, useRecipe on a completed trade and func_110297_a_'s trade sound hook. EntityVillager implements it on the server, NpcMerchant on the client.

members.name: setCustomer
members.note: buying_player is a flag plus a name, not an entity pointer; the container close clears it

members.name: getRecipes
members.note: the lazy default-offers build on the first trade

members.name: setRecipes
members.note: no NBT Recipes write path was found; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: useRecipe
members.note: uses tick-up, the yes sound's two pitch draws, the last-recipe 40-tick unlock

members.name: func_110297_a_
members.note: gated on livingSoundTime, called at the end of every resetRecipeAndSlots

notes: The server half lives in villagers.c and survival.c (displayGUIMerchant, useRecipe through SlotMerchantResult.onPickupFromSlot); the container's merchant_use/merchant_sound callbacks (container.h) carry the dispatch. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): offers load through readEntityFromNBT (trade-s1, persist-village-s42); NBT-driven setRecipes has no other caller. Formerly listed as missing: setRecipes (the NBT-driven custom recipe list) has no native write path; only the default offers built on first use exist. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records trade-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
